name: flutter_app
description: Flutter app scripts for running on emulators

scripts.android: flutter run -d $(flutter devices | grep android | awk '{print $4}' | head -1)
scripts.ios: flutter run -d $(flutter devices | grep iPhone | awk '{print $4}' | head -1)
scripts.android:emulator: flutter emulators --launch $(flutter emulators | grep android | head -1 | awk '{print $1}') && sleep 5 && flutter run -d emulator
scripts.ios:emulator: flutter emulators --launch $(flutter emulators | grep ios | head -1 | awk '{print $1}') && sleep 5 && flutter run -d iPhone
